# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 8 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 8
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. But what do you think is the type connected with the commandment given to Israel, that those men to whom the sin was committed, shall offer a heifer and slaughter it and burn it, and then the children shall take the ashes and put them into vessels, and bind scarlet wool around a piece of wood — here again you see the type of the cross and the scarlet wool — and hyssop, and so the children shall sprinkle the people one by one, that they may be purified from their sins?
2. Understand how in simplicity he speaks to you. The heifer is Jesus; the men who offer it are sinners who offered him to death. Afterwards there are no more men; the glory is no longer of sinners.
3. The children who sprinkle are those who preached to us the forgiveness of sins and the purification of the heart — those to whom he gave authority to preach the gospel, who are twelve in number as a type of the tribes of Israel, for there were twelve tribes of Israel.
4. And why are there three children who sprinkle? As a testimony to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, because these three were great before God.
5. And why is the wool on the wood? Because the kingdom of Jesus is on the wood, and because those who hope in him shall live forever.
6. And why is the wool and the hyssop together? Because in his kingdom there will be evil and foul days in which we shall be saved — for he who has pain in his flesh is healed through the foulness of hyssop.
7. And so these things are manifest to us, but obscure to them because they did not hear the voice of the Lord.
